## Why 2.0

- Compatibility: 889 scripts from 52 projects give the same output as in Git Bash 5.3.
- Tools: 250 commands built in, among them tar, zip, 7z, rar, gzip, bzip2, xz and zstd, all without anything else installed.
- Tests: 9,109, run on every release.
- Nothing that worked in 1.x breaks; 2.0 marks the milestone and keeps the version numbers short.
